input.quote: Except for termination for material breach as detailed in paragraph 4(b), Kubient shall be entitled to all fees generated during the termination period regardless of which Party terminates the Agreement
input.rationale: No liquidated damages, penalties, stipulated damages, shortfall charges or early-termination fees payable by AP appear anywhere in the Agreement, so the rule's preferred position (no Customer-payable liquidated damages) is met. Section 5 is a revenue-share arrangement under which payments flow from Kubient to AP, and AP's only monetary obligations are applicable sales/use taxes. The Section 4(a) statement that Kubient "shall be entitled to all fees generated during the termination period" is not a Customer-payable termination fee — it merely preserves Kubient's revenue-share on revenue actually generated during the 90-day notice period, and the mutual limitation of liability in Section 7(a) excludes punitive and special damages. Note for completeness that fee mechanics sit in the Exhibits, which are not part of this document and should be checked for any minimum-revenue or shortfall commitment payable by AP.
